verdict.rationale: Cline is itself a coding agent, so it occupies the MCP client role. Serving tools to other agents through an official MCP server is a different product role. The evidence shows only client-side MCP use (consuming and managing external MCP servers) and ACP embedding into editors. Nothing shows a Cline MCP server mode such as an 'mcp serve' subcommand or a hosted MCP endpoint, so this axis does not apply.
